source: Vision read of ALL 22 of the 22 flyer pages (weekly-1..22) pulled by pull-fareway-ads.ps1 at 06:30 on 2026-09-27 into a scratch directory (ad_group OmahaGroup (043); its manifest reports 22/22 pages, no gaps). Read by the grocery-browser-stores-refresh agent at 06:31-06:50 on 2026-09-27, before the 07:00 job installs the same pages. WINDOW TAKEN FROM THE AD'S OWN PRINTED FOOTER on page 1, 'Prices good September 28-October 3, 2026'. THE MANIFEST DISAGREES AND THE FOOTER WINS: the manifest says from=2026-09-27, one day earlier, the same one-day offset as the 09-14 and 09-20 ads. GAP DAY: the previous ad (fareway-deals-2026-09-20.json) ended 09-26 and this one starts 09-28, so Fareway has no ad rows for 2026-09-27; that is the ad calendar, not a missed capture. PAGES 12-22 REPRINT THE MONTHLY SEASONAL FLYER, printed 'September 28 - October 31, 2026' on monthly-1, so their prices hold for the whole of this weekly window and are recorded here. One conflict: AE Harvest Pumpkin Egg Nog is $3.99 qt on weekly page 7 and $4.44 quart on page 14 (the monthly price); the weekly page's $3.99 is recorded and the $4.44 is not. Fareway Cream Cheese $1.44 appears on pages 7 and 11 and is recorded once. EXCLUDED, deliberately, as prices the board cannot verify per unit: every 'WHEN YOU BUY N', 'SAVE $X WHEN YOU BUY N', BOGO / 'BUY 2 GET 1 FREE' / 'BUY 1 GET 1 50% OFF', FREE-with-purchase and gift-card-with-basket offer (among them Fareway Skinless Bratwurst B2G1, red/orange/yellow bell peppers BOGO, Pero vegetables, croutons, Rosina meatballs, 7up, Pepsi/Mountain Dew, Fareway Butter $2.48 when you buy 2, Campbell's condensed soup $1.67 when you buy 3, pomegranates 3/$4 when you buy 3 (single $2), Truly Yours caramels, Lily's Toaster Grills and the page 20-21 personal-care offers). Simple N/$X IS recorded at its arithmetic unit price with the multibuy kept in the item text. ALSO EXCLUDED: the WHOLE OF PAGE 8, the '3 DAY SALE - THURSDAY, OCTOBER 1 - SATURDAY, OCTOBER 3'. Those prices are good for 3 of the window's 6 days, and this file's schema carries ad_from/ad_to only at file level, so recording them would claim 09-28..10-03 for a price valid 10-01..10-03. Left out: All-Natural Iowa Pork Chops $1.88/lb, Top Sirloin Steak 10 oz $6.88, Tyson Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts 2.5 lb $6.99, Ragu Pasta Sauce 23.9-24 oz $1.99 (limit 2), Fareway Saltines or Oyster Crackers 12-16 oz $1.88, Mandarin Oranges 3 lb bag $4.77, Ball Park Buns 8 ct $1.99, and the conditional DiGiorno $5 when you buy 3 and Pepsi 3/$9.99 when you buy 3. King's Hawaiian Grab & Go Sandwich Trays (page 11) are excluded as day-conditional ($9.99 Wednesdays only, $19.99 other days). Pages 9 (beer half) and 10 (wine and spirits) carry no tracked grocery commodity and were read but contributed nothing.
